# `arxiv-kourgeorge` — upstream arXiv preprint style

`arxiv.sty` is vendored **verbatim** from
[kourgeorge/arxiv-style](https://github.com/kourgeorge/arxiv-style) (MIT, see
`License.txt`). It is not part of TeX Live, which is why it must be committed
here and materialized into each document directory — Overleaf compiles the
document subtree in isolation and could not fetch it.

**Do not edit this file.** If you want changes, use the `arxiv-custom` template,
which exists precisely so that local modifications have a home that is not a
fork of upstream.

## Pinned version

    commit 920514696f6e7270cab0558fd97c44515c63b4c4   (2024-01-02)

The committed `arxiv.sty` is byte-identical to upstream at that commit. Pin
rather than track `master`: refreshing then produces a diff you can read and
review, instead of whatever the branch happened to be on the day you ran it.

To refresh, bump the commit below **and** the one recorded above in the same
change, so the file and its provenance never disagree:

```bash
curl -sS -o tools/templates/arxiv-kourgeorge/arxiv.sty \
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kourgeorge/arxiv-style/<commit>/arxiv.sty
git diff tools/templates/arxiv-kourgeorge/arxiv.sty   # read it before accepting
make sync-bib && make papers        # verify every document still compiles
```

Find the candidates at
<https://github.com/kourgeorge/arxiv-style/commits/master/arxiv.sty>.

## Contributing back

This is the one upstream here with no automated return path: it is a style file
copied in, not a git subtree. A fix belongs in an ordinary pull request to
[kourgeorge/arxiv-style](https://github.com/kourgeorge/arxiv-style), after which
you bump the pin above. Note that `arxiv-custom.sty` is deliberately **ours** — a
patched fork with a documented delta, which goes nowhere upstream by design.

Only `geometry` and `fancyhdr` are required by the style — do not re-import
either in `main.tex`. It provides `\keywords{...}`, `\headeright` and
`\undertitle`, and redefines `\@maketitle` and the `abstract` environment.
